properties.description: Anthony, 2026-08-06: "first priority - fix the backlog issue. this is a bit embarrassing that reflow2 doesn't even use its graph to capture design decisions... this is a core reflow2 item that we still do not have right after 88 PRs and 218 BL items." The trigger was immediate and self-inflicted: this session violated dec:export-once-per-pr (accepted 2026-08-01), was caught by the gate, and then filed a backlog row blaming the gate — the third rediscovery of that decision, exactly as dec:idea-backlog-belongs-in-the-graph predicted.
properties.name: Defects found by USING reflow2 stop living only in markdown: they become TemporalFacts the graph can query (2026-08-06)
